productOnPage.title: The Nine Night Mystery
productOnPage.author: Sharna Jackson
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: A twisty and gripping murder-mystery from the award-winning author of High-Rise Mystery and The Good Turn. Brought to you by Penguin.  A gripping murder-mystery about identity, full of surprising twists, from the award-winning author of High-Rise Mystery and The Good Turn.  Last night Wesley and his friends Josephine and Margot threw their neighbour Rachel a surprise birthday party. This morning, Rachel is dead. And Wesley is the one who finds her body. Rachel's friends throw a traditional Caribbean Nine Night celebration to help guide her soul to the next world. But Wesley, Margot and Josephine don't have time to mourn Rachel. They are determined to find out who did this - and find out what secrets Rachel was keeping... Tracks included: Introduction
